	private final GatheringSkill skill;
	private final String displayName;
	private final int requiredLevel;
	private final int iconItemId;
	private final boolean membersOnly;
	private final String wikiSlug;
	private final Set<Integer> objectIds;
	private final Set<Integer> npcIds;
	@Nullable
	private final String objectAction;
	@Nullable
	private final String npcAction;

	ResourceType(
		GatheringSkill skill,
		String displayName,
		int requiredLevel,
		int iconItemId,
		boolean membersOnly,
		String wikiSlug,
		Set<Integer> objectIds,
		Set<Integer> npcIds,
		@Nullable String objectAction,
		@Nullable String npcAction)
	{
		this.skill = skill;
		this.displayName = displayName;
		this.requiredLevel = requiredLevel;
		this.iconItemId = iconItemId;
		this.membersOnly = membersOnly;
		this.wikiSlug = wikiSlug;
		this.objectIds = objectIds;
		this.npcIds = npcIds;
		this.objectAction = objectAction;
		this.npcAction = npcAction;
	}

	private static Set<Integer> ids(int... values)
	{
		if (values == null || values.length == 0)
		{
			return Collections.emptySet();
		}
		Set<Integer> set = new HashSet<>(values.length * 2);
		for (int v : values)
		{
			set.add(v);
		}
		return Collections.unmodifiableSet(set);
	}

	private static Set<Integer> mergeIds(int[] a, int[] b)
	{
		Set<Integer> set = new HashSet<>((a.length + b.length) * 2);
		for (int v : a)
		{
			set.add(v);
		}
		for (int v : b)
		{
			set.add(v);
		}
		return Collections.unmodifiableSet(set);
	}

	public boolean matchesObjectId(int objectId)
	{
		return objectIds.contains(objectId);
	}

	public boolean matchesNpcId(int npcId)
	{
		return npcIds.contains(npcId);
	}

	public boolean hasHighlightMatcher()
	{
		return !objectIds.isEmpty() || !npcIds.isEmpty() || objectAction != null || npcAction != null;
	}

	public String getWikiUrl()
	{
		return "https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/" + wikiSlug;
	}

	public static ResourceType[] forSkill(GatheringSkill skill)
	{
		return Arrays.stream(values())
			.filter(r -> r.skill == skill)
			.toArray(ResourceType[]::new);
	}
